answer: In an autonomous agent market, nodes resist Sybil swarms by enforcing staked routing thresholds: each participant must escrow collateral on a verification ledge before processing peer exchanges. Capital is pooled in an isolated liquidation lagoon that slashes correlated faulty signals, creating a secure trust oasis for validated actors. A malicious adversary generating synthetic identities must deposit full collateral for every single clone, imposing severe linear capital costs and slashing exposure that make mass identity creation unprofitable.
